summary: Do not ship. R-1 remains partly open: permit escape/liveness is fixed, but independent Writer Lanes remain mintable without tripping the gate. The replacement also exposes persistent reset writers through a public callback boundary.
triage: review-gate SKILL.md rules govern: render EVERY finding as a full table row, the human decides each row (accept/reject/defer/question — free text), echo back before applying, max 2 rounds, append decisions.md and COMMIT it with this artifact.

findings.title: R-1 still open: the gate counts files, not Writer Lane instances
findings.body: The bearer-token escape is fixed, but independent minting is not. The gate counts files containing `createWriterLane(` rather than call expressions or `createStateWriter` constructions. Because `createStateWriter` is an exported factory that creates a new lane on every call, two service-worker constructions—or two lane calls in the same permitted file—still produce `factoryCallers.length === 1`. The bundle check also passes because both markers remain worker-reachable. The resulting independent tails let later Backup increments overlap state/reset work and restore the lost-update class R-1 identified.
findings.recommendation: Enforce exactly one production `createStateWriter` construction and exactly one `createWriterLane` call expression, not one containing file. Add mutations for a second construction and a second same-file lane call and require both to fail the gate.

findings.title: `fullReset` reopens a caller-supplied persistent-write boundary inside the lane
findings.body: The new public door accepts `FullResetEffects`, which retains storage operations such as `removeBackupKeys`; the implementation spreads those caller-provided effects into `performFullReset` while holding the lane. This recreates the injected-dependency seam the fix says must disappear: a callback can fan out Backup read-modify-writes within one lane job, which the lane does not serialize internally. Ticket 02 must either preserve this bypass or break the load-bearing interface after callers and tests build on it.
findings.recommendation: Have `platform/state-writer.ts` directly import and own all storage adapters used by reset. Restrict the public reset argument to non-storage scheduling policy, such as suspend/resume callbacks, and test reset concurrency through the public StateWriter seam.

next_steps: Close the remaining independent-lane path and rerun the structure gate.
Remove persistent storage callbacks from `StateWriter.fullReset` before beginning ticket 02.
